g.text: The cost of starting a larger tier
Fresh server starts; OS page-cache state remains uncontrolled
Right panel adds the matching startup and first-request first-output times per start; it excludes validation and harness gaps.
This is not a directly captured command-to-token measurement or a cold-SSD claim. A larger tier can load more slowly.
